Rumizi has three plans. One is free forever and gets you a working digital
menu. The two paid ones lift every content limit and turn on the AI features —
the menu assistant your diners talk to, the Rumizi Assistant in your
workspace, and AI image generation.

AI menu extraction is **not** one of them: reading a photo or PDF into a
draft menu works on every plan, including Free.

## The plans

<Columns cols={3}>
  <Card title="Always Free" icon="gift">
    **\$0**

    One menu, up to 5 categories in it, up to 50 items total. No AI
    features.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Pro AI" icon="sparkles">
    **\$99 / month** or **\$990 / year**

    Unlimited menus, categories, and items. All AI features, with \$50 of
    AI usage per billing period.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Max AI" icon="rocket">
    **\$249 / month** or **\$2,490 / year**

    Everything in Pro, with \$150 of AI usage per billing period. For busy
    venues whose diners ask a lot.
  </Card>
</Columns>

## What each plan includes

| | Always Free | Pro AI | Max AI |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Price (monthly) | \$0 | \$99 | \$249 |
| Price (yearly) | — | \$990 | \$2,490 |
| Menus | 1 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Categories per menu | 5 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Items in total | 50 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Menu assistant for diners | — | Yes | Yes |
| AI image generation | — | Yes | Yes |
| AI usage per period | — | \$50 | \$150 |

Everything that isn't AI works on every plan: uploading and extracting a menu,
editing it, publishing, translations, open hours, tags, cross-sell,
availability, the gallery, brand images, the QR code, and staff accounts.

<Note>
Yearly billing is two months free on both paid plans.
</Note>

## Your first 30 days

New venues start on **30 days of Pro AI**, free and without a card. You get
the full product — unlimited content and every AI feature — while you decide
whether Rumizi is right for you.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Sign up">
    Your venue is created on Pro AI for 30 days.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Build and publish">
    Upload your menu, edit it, publish it, put the QR code on the tables.
    Nothing is gated during the trial.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Subscribe before day 30">
    Open **Billing** and pick Pro or Max. Nothing changes for your diners.
  </Step>
</Steps>

### What happens if you don't subscribe

When the trial ends without a subscription, your venue moves to **Always
Free**. It is not blocked and your menu is not taken down — your public menu
stays live and scannable.

What you lose is the AI and the headroom:

- The **menu assistant stops answering** your diners — it replies that the
  feature isn't available on your plan instead of recommending dishes. If
  you're staying on Free, email me and I'll turn the chat off for your venue
  so your link opens the menu directly.
- **AI image generation** and the workspace **Rumizi Assistant** switch off.
- You're back inside the Free limits: 1 menu, 5 categories, 50 items.

Uploading a menu file and extracting it with AI keeps working.

<Warning>
If your menu is over 50 items when you drop to Free, the items stay in your
workspace but you can't **publish** until you're back under the limit or on a
paid plan. Diners keep seeing the last version you published.
</Warning>

Subscribing at any point restores everything immediately — nothing is deleted
while you're on Free.

## Subscribe

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open Billing">
    In your workspace, open **More → Billing**. Direct URL:
    `rumizi.com/your-venue/w/billing`. Billing is owner-only — staff accounts
    don't see it.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Pick a plan and a cadence">
    Choose **Pro AI** or **Max AI**, then monthly or yearly. You're
    redirected to Stripe's secure checkout.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Pay">
    Fill in your card details on Stripe. Rumizi never sees your card number.
  </Step>
  <Step title="You're active">
    Stripe confirms back to Rumizi and your plan switches over. Head back to
    your workspace.
  </Step>
</Steps>

You can move between Pro and Max the same way — open Billing and pick the
other plan.

## AI usage and the spend cap

Paid plans include a budget of AI usage per billing period: **\$50 on Pro**,
**\$150 on Max**. The Billing page shows a bar with how much of it you've used
and when it resets.

Almost no venue reaches it. It exists so that a venue that gets an unusual
amount of chat traffic doesn't generate an unbounded bill. If you do hit the
cap:

- **Text AI keeps working** on a smaller, cheaper model, so your diners still
  get answers.
- **AI image generation pauses** until the period resets.

Upgrading from Pro to Max raises the cap straight away.

## Cancelling and card changes

Two things aren't in the app yet:

- **Cancelling** — email [hi@rumizi.com](mailto:hi@rumizi.com) and I'll cancel
  it for you and confirm.
- **Changing your card** — same, email me.

Billing is **USD only**. That's separate from your menu prices, which you can
set in any currency — see [Menu theme](/vendors/venue/theme).

## 100% satisfaction

If Rumizi doesn't work for you in the first month, email
[hi@rumizi.com](mailto:hi@rumizi.com) and I'll sort it out personally.
